title: Bullet Hit FX
description: Peter-approved 16px bullet hits (2026-10-15). Feel-booth preview only — not wired into live combat. fx-hit-fire and fx-hit-water are 5×16 @ 20 fps (~0.25s), once, origin (0.5, 0.5) at the impact point. Display size is the bullet / pellet (these frames are already 16px). No extra scale multiplier unless Gameplay later wants a 1.25× punch. Blend ADD or NORMAL; the feel booth uses ADD. 24px upscales are not cataloged. fx-hit-electric is not in this wave.
